post.text:
I was fired from Anthropic today.

I was the engineer responsible for shipping the latest  dev/claude-code npm package. Wanting to improve the debugging experience for the team, I decided to include source maps in the release. This resulted in our entire internal codebase being https://t.co/5Oz0PpI8jj

referenced_tweet_data.text:
Claude code source code has been leaked via a map file in their npm registry! 

Code: https://t.co/jBiMoOzt8G https://t.co/rYo5hbvEj8

description.description: A screenshot of a terminal window displaying command-line interface output. The user 'shou@dev' has executed 'ls -alht' on a file named cli.js.map and a directory named 'src'. The output shows a long list of files and directories with their permissions, owner (shou), group (staff), file sizes, timestamps (Mar 31 01:17), and names. The list includes various typescript files (.ts, .tsx) and subdirectories like entrypoints, commands, components, and hooks.
